name: Screen Effects
summary: Shake, flash, fade and hit-stop — the four that make a hit feel like a hit.
description: One director other scripts call: shake(strength) kicks the camera and decays, flash(colour) blinks a full-screen tint, fadeTo/fadeFrom cover the screen for a scene change, and hitStop(seconds) freezes time for a moment on a heavy blow. All four go through the shared contract, so they behave the same in the browser and natively, and the flash and fade use the screen-space UI rather than a world-space quad that a moving camera would drag around.
nextSteps: Put Effects.js on an empty actor and tag it Effects.
Call shake(12) when something lands and flash('#ffffff') when the player is hit.
If a camera script writes the camera position every frame, let it run first — this offsets in onLateUpdate.
